AMPLIFIED. UPGRADED. AWESOME.

HARMONY OF THE SEAS

SHOP NOW

The newly Amplified Harmony of the Seas® is geared up for maxed-out vacations.

Crush every craving with mouthwatering bites at over 20 venues, including bold flavors at the brand-new Samba Grill Brazilian Steakhouse. Turn up after dark with all new nightlife at Playmakers℠ Sports Bar & Arcade and with an expanded new casino — the largest in the fleet. Conquer daredevil-worthy feats together on The Perfect Storm℠ waterslides, then soar over the Boardwalk® on a high-flying zipline ride. And with tropical sips from The Lime and Coconut®, you can make it your chillest day yet on the revamped pool deck.

BRAND NEW BOLD ADVENTURES

This is not your average family vacation — this is so much more. The newly Amplified Harmony of the Seas is loaded with thrills and unforgettable experiences for all ages. From thrilling slides and bold bites to nightlife that dazzles and shows that wow. You’ve never experienced adventure like this before — only on Royal Caribbean®.

ONBOARD ACTIVITIES

Soak up peak relaxation at three pools and ten whirlpools or enjoy sweeping ocean views and adults-only tranquility at the enhanced Solarium. Challenge your whole crew to an all-new laser tag battle and fly nine stories high on the Zip Line. Or grab the fam and race down The Perfect Storm℠ waterslides for the splashiest ride of your life.

EXPLORE ONBOARD ACTIVITIES

DINING

Sink your teeth into mouthwatering meals at 20 eateries. Stop by the brand-new El Loco Fresh® for south-of-the border staples like tacos, burritos, carnitas and more. Or fire up the flavor with succulent slow roasted meats carved tableside at the new Samba Grill Brazilian Steakhouse. Plus, find fleet favorites like Izumi Hibachi & Sushi℠, Chops Grille℠, and more.

EXPLORE ONBOARD DINING

NIGHTLIFE 

Have the time of your life every night with 12 electrifying spots to grab a drink, including four shows and six live music venues. Sip tropical concoctions at Pesky Parrot℠. Cheer on your home team at Playmakers℠ Sports Bar & Arcade. Win big at the largest Casino Royale℠ ever, with 37 table games and over 500 slot machines. Plus, don’t miss the mesmerizing, stunt-filled shows across ice, air, water and stage.

EXPLORE NIGHTLIFE

THRILLS AND CHILL
ALL AMPED UP

Explore awe-inspiring beaches when you sail on the newly Amplified Harmony of the Seas® to the Caribbean from Port Canaveral in Orlando. And go Ultimate Destinations℠ pioneering at Perfect Day CocoCay or Royal Beach Club℠ Paradise Island in The Bahamas.

OUR BOLD
ROYAL AMPLIFIED SHIPS

Royal Caribbean® is amping up your favorite cruise ships with never-before-seen thrills, the cuisines you crave, and more unforgettable experiences day and night. This is Royal Amplified℠ — the future of adventure.

EXPLORE OUR AMPLIFIED CRUISE SHIPS

WHAT TO KNOW
BEFORE YOU GO
Max out thrills onboard Harmony of the Seas® boasting 1,188 feet of wow-worthy adventures. Bring on the bold with adrenaline amping activities like deck-defying ziplining, two FlowRider®* surf simulators, and the Ultimate Abyss℠ — the tallest waterslide at sea. When you’re ready to refuel, our food and beverage crew is over 1,000 strong, and ready to cater to your every need. Indulge with delicious dining choices from fresh sushi rolls at Izumi to mouthwatering specialty cuts at Chops Grille℠. And when the sun goes down, spellbinding performances crank up with ice-skating performances and stellar theater productions. Check out our guides for additional tips on an adventure packed vacation onboard the world’s boldest ships.
